responsibility: Implements the late RTL pass that inserts landing-pad check instructions for RISC-V forward-control-flow integrity support. When Zicfilp-style protection is enabled, it scans functions and basic blocks to place `lpad` instructions at indirect-call entry points, preserved or non-local-goto labels, and other indirect branch targets, handling special save/restore sequences as needed so generated code meets the target’s branch-target identification requirements.
